reason: A client-side DeepSeek Harness plugin focused on improving modal window layout and interaction through dragging, resizing, pinning, maximizing, backdrop controls, and local persistence.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页弹窗提供拖动、调整大小、固定、最大化、背景遮罩控制和状态持久化功能。
summaries.en: Enhances DeepSeek Harness web modals with dragging, resizing, pinning, maximizing, backdrop controls, and persistent per-dialog settings.

capabilities: Enhances web modal dialogs with dragging, resizing, pinning, maximizing, and backdrop controls
Injects scoped client-side styles and event listeners into matching dialogs
Observes mounted dialogs in the browser DOM
Persists per-dialog UI state in browser localStorage
Provides a General-settings toggle to enable or disable the enhancer
